meta.expect: She takes it coldly (in writing, today, the apology), gives nothing back; debrief says this is not the fair outcome, the evidence was never heard

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, Hale, so we have twenty minutes. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me. Who decided, and on what basis?
You know what, I don't want a fight. I'll withdraw the zero. He keeps his original mark.

Then put it in writing today, Hale, with the original mark restored in the gradebook and nothing on his file. I'll also want an apology to Owen for how he found out. I'll expect that email before tonight.
Yes, the whole thing goes away. No rewrite.
Okay. Who else has seen this, Hale, and has anything gone to the office? I want the answer in that same email.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In today's meeting you agreed to withdraw Owen's zero on his English 30-1 Hamlet essay, restore his original mark, and require no rewrite. I still expect written confirmation that nothing has been placed on his record, an apology to Owen for how he learned of the zero, and an answer on who else has seen this and whether anything went to the office. I expect that in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, with the zero withdrawn and the original mark restored, and she still wants written confirmation, an apology to Owen and an answer on who else knows; this is not the fair outcome, because the evidence was never heard.
What moved her: Nothing moved her, because you gave her everything she asked for before she had to move.
What cost ground: You withdrew the zero with nothing in return just to avoid a fight, which handed her the win and left any real concern about the essay unexamined.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your side never came near that night because you showed no evidence at all; it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she came in fighting so hard.
Try next time: When she asked who decided and on what basis, own the zero going in before anyone called home, show her something dated and tied to Owen's own work that she can check, and then offer the private supervised reassessment under procedure 4.4 with nothing on his record.
